description: Daily credit risk exposure mart (Hive SQL)

components.name: Build exposure
components.sql:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mart.risk_exposure PARTITION (dt='${RUN_DATE}')
SELECT c.segment, SUM(t.amount_usd) FROM `dw`.`txn_enriched` t JOIN dw.customer_dim c ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id GROUP BY c.segment
